mapper.select: SELECT `id` as id, `name` as name FROM `nationalities` AND name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}
SELECT `id` as id, `name` as name FROM `groups` WHERE `is_active` = 1 AND name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}

SELECT `id` as id, CONCAT(users.first_name, ' ', users.last_name) as fullName FROM `users` WHERE `is_active` = 1 AND user_type != 3 AND (users.first_name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR users.last_name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%")) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}
SELECT `id` as id, `name` as name FROM `companies` WHERE `is_active` = 1 AND name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}

SELECT `id` as id, `name` as name FROM `chart_account_types` WHERE `is_active` IN (0, 1) AND name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}
SELECT `id` as id, `name` as name FROM `classes` WHERE `is_active` = 1 AND name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}
SELECT `id` as id, `name` as name FROM `products` WHERE `is_active` = 1 AND name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}
SELECT `id` as id, `name` as name FROM `account_types` WHERE 1 AND name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") ORDER BY `ordering` ASC LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}

SELECT `id` as id, parent_id AS parentId, CONCAT(`account_codes`, ' - ', `account_description`) as name FROM `chart_accounts` WHERE `is_active` = 1 AND `account_description` LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}

SELECT ca.id as id, ca.chart_account_type_id as chartAccountTypeId, ca.parent_id as parentId, CONCAT(ca.account_codes, ' - ', ca.account_description) as name, (SELECT SUM(debit) - SUM(credit) FROM general_ledgers gl INNER JOIN general_ledger_details gld ON gl.id=gld.general_ledger_id WHERE is_active=1 AND is_approve=1 AND chart_account_id = ca.id ) AS balance FROM chart_accounts ca LEFT JOIN chart_accounts child ON child.parent_id = ca.id AND child.is_active = 1 WHERE ca.is_active = 1
AND ca.chart_account_type_id = 10 AND child.id IS NULL
AND ca.chart_account_type_id IN (11,13,14,15) AND child.id IS NULL
AND ca.account_description LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") GROUP BY ca.id ORDER BY ca.id ASC LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}
SELECT `id` as id, `name` as name FROM `date_formats` WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}
SELECT `id` as id, `name` as name FROM `time_formats` WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}

SELECT reconciles.id AS id, reconciles.date AS date, chart_accounts.id AS chartAccountId, chart_accounts.account_codes AS chartAccountCode, chart_accounts.account_description AS chartAccountName FROM reconciles LEFT JOIN chart_accounts ON chart_accounts.id = reconciles.chart_account_id WHERE reconciles.is_active = 1 ORDER BY reconciles.id DESC LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}
SELECT branches.id AS id, branches.name AS name FROM branches WHERE is_active = 1
SELECT branche_types.id AS id, branche_types.name AS name FROM branche_types WHERE is_active = 1
SELECT location_groups.id AS id, location_groups.name AS name FROM location_groups WHERE is_active = 1
SELECT countries.id AS id, countries.name AS name FROM countries

SELECT company_currencies.currency_center_id AS currencyCenterId, company_currencies.exchange_rate_id AS exchangeRateId, company_currencies.rate_to_sell AS rateToSell, company_currencies.rate_to_purchase AS rateToPurchase, currency_centers.symbol AS symbol, currency_centers.name AS name FROM company_currencies INNER JOIN currency_centers ON currency_centers.id = company_currencies.currency_center_id WHERE company_currencies.is_active = 1

SELECT COUNT(id) FROM purchase_requests WHERE purchase_requests.is_close = 0 AND purchase_requests.status > 0 AND (purchase_requests.total_amount + purchase_requests.total_vat) > IFNULL(purchase_requests.total_deposit,0)
AND purchase_requests.company_id = #{filter.companyId}

SELECT COUNT(id) FROM purchase_orders WHERE status > 0 AND purchase_orders.balance > 0
AND purchase_orders.company_id = #{filter.companyId}

SELECT COUNT(id) FROM quotations WHERE status > 0 AND is_close = 0 AND ((quotations.total_amount - IFNULL(quotations.discount, 0)) + quotations.total_vat) > IFNULL(quotations.total_deposit, 0)
AND quotations.company_id = #{filter.companyId}

SELECT COUNT(id) FROM sales_orders WHERE status > 0 AND balance > 0
AND company_id = #{filter.companyId}

SELECT
journal_entry_code
receive_payment_code
receive_payment_org_code
receive_payment_emp_code
pay_bill_code
pay_journal_code
FROM branches WHERE id = #{filter.branchId} AND is_active = 1;

( SELECT 1 AS `type`, purchase_order_details.id AS id, purchase_order_details.product_id AS itemId, products.name AS itemName, products.code AS itemCode, products.code AS sku, products.barcode AS upc, purchase_order_details.qty AS qty, IFNULL(products.small_val_uom, 1) / IFNULL(purchase_order_details.conversion, 1) AS conversion, purchase_order_details.qty_uom_id AS uomId, uoms.name AS uomName, uoms.abbr AS uomAbbr, purchase_order_details.unit_cost AS unitCost, purchase_order_details.total_cost AS totalCost, purchase_order_details.note AS note FROM purchase_order_details LEFT JOIN products ON products.id = purchase_order_details.product_id LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = purchase_order_details.qty_uom_id WHERE purchase_order_details.purchase_order_id = #{id} ) UNION ( SELECT 2 AS `type`, purchase_order_services.id AS id, purchase_order_services.service_id AS itemId, services.name AS itemName, services.sku AS itemCode, services.sku AS sku, services.sku AS upc, purchase_order_services.qty AS qty, 1 AS conversion, NULL AS uomId, NULL AS uomName, NULL AS uomAbbr, purchase_order_services.unit_cost AS unitCost, purchase_order_services.total_cost AS totalCost, purchase_order_services.note AS note FROM purchase_order_services LEFT JOIN services ON services.id = purchase_order_services.service_id WHERE purchase_order_services.purchase_order_id = #{id} ) ORDER BY `type` DESC, id ASC

( SELECT 1 AS `type`, purchase_request_details.id AS id, purchase_request_details.product_id AS itemId, products.name AS itemName, products.code AS itemCode, products.code AS sku, products.barcode AS upc, purchase_request_details.qty AS qty, IFNULL(products.small_val_uom,1) / IFNULL(purchase_request_details.conversion, 1) AS conversion, purchase_request_details.qty_uom_id AS uomId, uoms.name AS uomName, uoms.abbr AS uomAbbr, purchase_request_details.unit_cost AS unitCost, purchase_request_details.total_cost AS totalCost, purchase_request_details.note AS note FROM purchase_request_details LEFT JOIN products ON products.id = purchase_request_details.product_id LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = purchase_request_details.qty_uom_id WHERE purchase_request_details.purchase_request_id = #{id} ) UNION ( SELECT 2 AS `type`, purchase_request_services.id AS id, purchase_request_services.service_id AS itemId, services.name AS itemName, services.sku AS itemCode, services.sku AS sku, services.sku AS upc, purchase_request_services.qty AS qty, 1 AS conversion, NULL AS uomId, NULL AS uomName, NULL AS uomAbbr, purchase_request_services.unit_cost AS unitCost, purchase_request_services.total_cost AS totalCost, purchase_request_services.note AS note FROM purchase_request_services LEFT JOIN services ON services.id = purchase_request_services.service_id WHERE purchase_request_services.purchase_request_id = #{id} ) ORDER BY `type` DESC, id ASC

SELECT
3 AS isVat FROM `customers` WHERE `is_active` = 1
AND (customers.name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR customers.name_kh LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR customers.customer_code LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR customers.main_number LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR customers.mobile_number LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR customers.other_number LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM membership_cards WHERE membership_cards.customer_id = customers.id AND membership_cards.is_active = 1 AND membership_cards.card_id LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") ) )
ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}

SELECT
CASE WHEN sales_orders.total_vat > 0 THEN 1 WHEN sales_orders.total_vat = 0 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS isVat FROM `customers` INNER JOIN sales_orders ON sales_orders.customer_id = customers.id WHERE customers.`is_active` > 0 AND sales_orders.status > 0 AND sales_orders.balance > 0
AND (customers.name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR customers.name_kh LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR customers.customer_code LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR customers.main_number LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR customers.mobile_number LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR customers.other_number LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM membership_cards WHERE membership_cards.customer_id = customers.id AND membership_cards.is_active = 1 AND membership_cards.card_id LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") ) )
GROUP BY customers.id ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}
